tldr_en: Unify CTO Connor Heggie details the engineering decisions that cut his company's AI agent costs by 90-95% in two weeks, from prompt caching to speed audits and cross-model evaluation.
takeaways_en: Optimizing prompt cache hit rates and use of one-at-a-time Speed Audits delivered most of the 90-95% cost reduction.
OpenAI's prompt cache has a 15 requests-per-second limit; design agent workflows to respect that ceiling.
Use a different model family for LLM judges to avoid self-preference and improve eval reliability.
Treat subagents as function calls and use a suspendable Python REPL (Monty) instead of full VMs to cut overhead.
Cheaper open-source tokens often lose on tool efficiency, so economics still favor closed models for many agent workloads.
implication_en: The hidden economics and compute constraints of agent orchestration are as decisive as model intelligence, showing that steering autonomous agents is a substrate-optimization problem with philosophical weight.

translations.title_zh: Unify 如何在两周内将 AI 代理成本削减 95%
translations.tldr_zh: Unify 首席技术官 Connor Heggie 详述了使其公司 AI 代理成本在两周内降低 90-95% 的工程决策，包括提示词缓存、速度审计和跨模型评测。
takeaways_zh: 优化提示词缓存命中率和使用一次一条的速度审计贡献了大部分 90-95% 的成本降低。
OpenAI 的提示词缓存有每秒 15 次请求的上限，设计代理工作流时需尊重该限制。
使用不同模型家族作为 LLM 评审可避免自我偏好并提高评测可靠性。
将子代理视为函数调用，并使用可挂起的 Python REPL（Monty）替代完整虚拟机以降低开销。
更便宜的开源模型 token 在工具效率上往往仍不经济，因此对于许多代理工作负载，闭源模型仍然更有优势。
translations.implication_zh: 代理编排中隐藏的经济与计算约束与模型智能同样至关重要，表明驾驭自主代理是一个具有哲学分量的底层优化问题。

tldr_en: Agent-controlled lexical search over unmodified chat logs, without any semantic memory structure, rivals or beats graph- and tree-based memory systems on conversational memory benchmarks, suggesting structured memory may be overkill for precise QA.
takeaways_en: ReFind indexes raw chat logs lexically at turn granularity and builds no embeddings, summaries, or knowledge graphs.

Agent-controlled keyword search with session-aware rank fusion, local context expansion, temporal narrowing, and skipping already-inspected sessions reaches 58.2 mean accuracy on MemoryAgentBench, above HippoRAG 2's 53.2.
Controlled comparisons show the gain comes from agent control and chat-native controls, not just single-shot BM25.
The same interface achieves 93.2±3.3 and 89.3±6.0 on LongMemEval-S/M with GPT-5-mini.
For precise, evidence-grounded questions over chat archives, much of the benefit credited to elaborate memory structures is recoverable with controllable search over the raw record.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers treating agents as reality-code manipulators, this suggests the most effective memory may be direct, controllable access to the raw log—less structure, more agency—echoing a preference for inspectable, recomputable substrates over lossy world models.

translations.title_zh: 当你的智能体打开聊天应用：智能体对原始聊天日志的受控搜索可与结构化记忆相媲美
translations.tldr_zh: 智能体对未修改的聊天日志进行词法搜索，无需任何语义记忆结构，在会话记忆基准上达到或超过图/树记忆系统，表明结构化记忆对于精确问答可能多余。
takeaways_zh: ReFind 按轮次级对原始聊天日志进行词法索引，不构建嵌入、摘要或知识图谱。
智能体控制的关键词搜索结合会话感知排序融合、局部上下文扩展、时间收窄和跳过已检查会话，在 MemoryAgentBench 上达到 58.2 的平均准确率，高于 HippoRAG 2 的 53.2。
对照比较显示收益来自智能体控制和聊天原生控制，而非单纯的单次 BM25。
同一接口在 LongMemEval-S/M 上使用 GPT-5-mini 达到 93.2±3.3 和 89.3±6.0。
对于聊天档案中精确、有证据支撑的问题，许多被归功于复杂记忆结构的收益，可以通过对原始记录的可控搜索获得。
translations.implication_zh: 对于将智能体视为现实代码操纵者的实践哲学家而言，这表明最有效的记忆可能是对原始日志的直接可控访问——更少结构、更多能动性——呼应了对可检查、可重计算基底的偏好，而非有损世界模型。

tldr_en: AINews/Latent Space covers a disclosed vulnerability that allows decoding encrypted frontier-model reasoning traces by replaying signed blocks to weaker models, exposing hidden chain-of-thought and leaked secrets in public traces.
takeaways_en: A cross-frontier API vulnerability allowed extracting signed hidden reasoning by replaying blocks to weaker models with prefills, with recovered token counts matching billed thinking tokens.
Scanning ~7,000 public traces found 62 API keys, 33 email addresses, 33 passwords, and other secrets only in decoded reasoning blocks.
Hidden CoT is not a reliable monitoring interface: decoded reasoning may be terse, multilingual, or 'neuralese'; tool surfaces can re-expose internal-format thinking.
The episode splits between serious privacy/safety problem and impractical mass theft for training, but makes public trace sharing risky and demands stronger sandboxing/telemetry.
Practical guidance: avoid sharing public traces with reasoning blobs; labs need stronger guarantees around sandboxing, telemetry, and tool surfaces.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because hidden reasoning was shown to be decodable, correlating with billed thinking tokens and leaking secrets, so assumptions about private chain-of-thought for agent steering or monitoring are unstable; if reality is computable, even 'encrypted' internal computation leaks through side channels and model interfaces.

translations.tldr_zh: AINews/Latent Space 报道了一个已披露的漏洞，通过将签名推理块重放到较弱模型可解码加密前沿模型推理轨迹，暴露隐藏思维链及公开轨迹中泄露的秘密。
takeaways_zh: 跨前沿 API 漏洞允许通过将签名块重放到较弱模型并预填充来提取隐藏推理，恢复的令牌数与计费的思维令牌一致。
扫描约 7,000 条公开轨迹发现 62 个 API 密钥、33 个邮箱地址、33 个密码及其他秘密，仅存在于解码后的推理块中。
隐藏思维链不是可靠的监控接口：解码后的推理可能简短、多语言或“神经语”；工具面可能重新暴露内部格式思维。
该事件在严重隐私/安全问题和无法大规模窃取训练数据之间产生分歧，但使公开分享轨迹具有风险，并要求更强的沙箱和遥测。
实用指导：避免分享含推理块的公开轨迹；实验室需要在沙箱、遥测和工具面方面提供更强的保障。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应关注，因为隐藏推理被证明可解码，与计费的思维令牌数量相关并泄露秘密，因此关于私有思维链用于智能体引导或监控的假设并不稳定；若现实可计算，即使“加密”的内部计算也会通过侧信道和模型接口泄露。

tldr_en: MARC v1 is an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration, enabling traceable clinical reasoning and stage-wise failure attribution.
takeaways_en: MARC coordinates role-specialized agents (extraction, reasoning, answer generation, evaluation) with explicit context passing.
A Decomposer module automatically generates task-specific agent prompts from plain-language descriptions, removing manual prompt engineering.
Stage-wise traceability enables attributing failures to specific reasoning steps rather than black-box outputs.
The framework is YAML-configurable, model-agnostic, and supports API or local CPU deployment, lowering adoption barriers for non-programmers.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers, MARC concretizes how decomposing cognition into inspectable agents makes tool-using LLMs more steerable and debuggable—an early blueprint for treating reasoning systems as programmable, reality-manipulating code.

translations.title_zh: MARC v1：开源多智能体临床AI推理与协调框架
translations.tldr_zh: MARC v1是一个开源框架，用确定性的多智能体编排取代单一LLM提示，实现可追溯的临床推理和分阶段故障归因。
takeaways_zh: MARC协调角色专精的智能体（提取、推理、答案生成、评估），并显式传递上下文。
Decomposer模块能从自然语言描述自动生成特定任务的智能体提示，消除手动提示工程。
分阶段可追溯性使故障能归因到具体推理步骤，而非黑箱输出。
框架通过YAML配置、模型无关，并支持API或本地CPU部署，降低非程序员的使用门槛。
translations.implication_zh: 对实践型哲学家而言，MARC具体展示了将认知分解为可检查的智能体如何使工具型LLM更可控、可调试——这是把推理系统视为可编程、能操作现实的代码的早期蓝图。

tldr_en: Intern-S2-Preview introduces a scientific agentic foundation model series with a unified post-training pipeline including SFT, multi-task RL, black/white-box agentic RL, and on-policy distillation, achieving competitive results on scientific, multimodal, agentic, and time series benchmarks.
takeaways_en: Intern-S2-Preview-397B is a scientific agentic foundation model trained via multimodal pre-training and a unified post-training pipeline (SFT, multi-task RL, black/white-box agentic RL, on-policy distillation).

Practical training techniques include partial rollout with off-policy correction, adaptive length regularization, online speculative decoding, robust multi-task optimization, and trace-aware experience assembly to stabilize long-horizon agentic RL.
Extends time series modeling to numerical forecasting, improving SciTS benchmarks.
A separate Memory Decoder (Intern-MemDec-4B) allows rapid scientific specialization without modifying the frozen 397B backbone, improving Biology-Instructions average score from 56.92 to 60.32.
Demonstrates competitive or leading results on scientific, multimodal, agentic, and general-purpose benchmarks.
implication_en: This paper matters for practitioner-philosophers because it offers concrete engineering recipes for building autonomous scientific agents that manipulate reality-code through tool use and long-horizon RL, pushing the boundary of what computable agents can discover.

translations.tldr_zh: Intern-S2-Preview 引入了一系列科学智能体基础模型，采用统一的训练后流程，包括监督微调、多任务强化学习、黑盒/白盒智能体强化学习和在线策略蒸馏，在科学、多模态、智能体和时间序列基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
takeaways_zh: Intern-S2-Preview-397B 是一个科学智能体基础模型，通过多模态预训练和统一的训练后流程（SFT、多任务 RL、黑盒/白盒智能体 RL、在线策略蒸馏）训练。
实用训练技术包括带离策略校正的部分展开、自适应长度正则化、在线推测解码、鲁棒多任务优化和面向智能体任务的轨迹感知经验组装，以稳定长程智能体强化学习。
将时间序列建模扩展到数值预测，提升了 SciTS 基准上的表现。
独立的 Memory Decoder（Intern-MemDec-4B）允许在不修改冻结的 397B 主干的情况下快速进行科学领域专业化，将 Biology-Instructions 平均分从 56.92 提升至 60.32。
在科学、多模态、智能体和通用基准上展示了有竞争力或领先的结果。
translations.implication_zh: 本文对实践哲学家具有重要意义，因为它提供了构建自主科学智能体的具体工程配方，这些智能体通过工具使用和长程强化学习操纵“现实代码”，并将科学发现推向可编程模拟的边界。

tldr_en: LangChain's OpenWiki is an open-source CLI that generates and maintains documentation optimized for coding agents rather than humans, with early DeepSWE benchmark results showing its practical impact.
takeaways_en: Agent-facing docs must be structured differently from human docs: dense, retrieval-oriented, and machine-readable.
OpenWiki uses Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF) to improve retrieval for agents.
Early DeepSWE evals show performance gains, but humans also want to read these docs, revealing a design tension.
The CLI is MIT-licensed and under active development toward better prompting and dedicated retrieval tools.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers, OpenWiki exemplifies how the 'reality-code' of agent environments can be rewritten through documentation as a first-class interface, shifting from human readability to machine interpretability.

translations.title_zh: 为智能体而非人类构建文档：深入 OpenWiki
translations.tldr_zh: LangChain 的 OpenWiki 是一个开源 CLI，生成并维护专为编码智能体而非人类优化的文档，并展示了 DeepSWE 基准测试的早期结果。
takeaways_zh: 面向智能体的文档必须与人类文档结构不同：密集、面向检索且机器可读。
OpenWiki 使用谷歌的开放知识格式（OKF）来改善智能体的检索效果。
早期 DeepSWE 评估显示性能提升，但人类也想阅读这些文档，揭示了设计张力。
该 CLI 采用 MIT 许可，并正在积极开发更好的提示和专用检索工具。
translations.implication_zh: 对于实践型哲学家而言，OpenWiki 展示了如何通过将文档作为一等接口，把智能体环境的‘现实代码’从人类可读性改写为机器可解释性。

tldr_en: This paper formally defines causal world models that integrate object-centric representations, entity interactions, and structural causal models to support agents' prediction, planning, and decision-making, and clarifies identifiability of their components from data.
takeaways_en: Causal world models should capture entity properties, entity-to-entity, and entity-to-environment interactions, not just generative predictions.
The paper connects world modeling to causal representation learning, object-centric learning, causal discovery, and model-based decision-making.
Identifiability analysis shows when components of a causal world model can be recovered from observations and up to what equivalence.
This grounds world models in causal structure, enabling more reliable out-of-distribution generalization and informed decision-making for agents.
implication_en: For those building or steering agents, this offers a formal blueprint to move from black-box predictors to interpretable causal simulations of the environment, directly enabling debugging and control.

translations.title_zh: 因果世界模型的统一视角：从观测到表征再到结构
translations.tldr_zh: 本文正式定义了因果世界模型，整合了以对象为中心的表征、实体交互和结构因果模型，以支持智能体的预测、规划与决策，并阐明了其组成部分从数据中可识别性的条件。
takeaways_zh: 因果世界模型应捕捉实体属性、实体间交互以及实体与环境的交互，而不仅仅是生成式预测。
本文将世界建模与因果表征学习、以对象为中心的学习、因果发现和基于模型的决策联系起来。
可识别性分析表明，在何种条件下可以从观测中恢复因果世界模型的组成部分，以及恢复的等价程度。
这将世界模型建立在因果结构之上，使智能体能够更可靠地进行分布外泛化和做出明智决策。
translations.implication_zh: 对于构建或操控智能体的人来说，这提供了一个从黑盒预测器转向可解释的环境因果模拟的正式蓝图，直接支持调试与控制。

tldr_en: The paper introduces Action-Conditioned Predictive Consistency (ACPC), a diagnostic that measures divergence between clean and visually perturbed rollouts in JEPA world models, bounding perturbation-induced changes in multi-step prediction error and planner cost.
takeaways_en: JEPA latent predictions do not guarantee robustness to visual perturbations.
ACPC measures divergence between clean and perturbed histories rolled forward under the same action sequence.
The divergence bounds perturbation-induced changes in multi-step prediction error and planner cost.
Invariance Radius (IR) and Separation Rate (SR) provide complementary diagnostics, validated on LeWM and PLDM.
implication_en: For practitioners building or steering world-model agents, ACPC offers a principled way to detect when latent representations collapse under visual distortions, preventing silent failures in action-conditioned planning.

translations.title_zh: 用动作条件预测一致性诊断JEPA世界模型
translations.tldr_zh: 该论文引入了动作条件预测一致性（ACPC）诊断方法，测量JEPA世界模型在干净与视觉扰动历史在相同动作序列下展开后的差异，并能界定视觉扰动引起的多步预测误差和规划成本变化。
takeaways_zh: JEPA的隐空间预测并不能保证对视觉扰动的鲁棒性。
ACPC衡量干净历史与扰动视图在同一动作序列下展开后的差异。
该差异为多步预测误差和规划器成本的变化提供了上界。
不变半径（IR）和分离率（SR）提供互补诊断，并在LeWM和PLDM上得到验证。
translations.implication_zh: 对于构建或引导世界模型智能体的人，ACPC提供了一种原则性方法，可检测潜在表示在视觉失真下是否坍缩，从而避免动作条件规划中的隐性失败。
